_comment: Terminal rules for GitHub Copilot in VS Code. They belong in each operator's VS Code User settings under chat.tools.terminal.autoApprove; Copilot ignores them in workspace settings. Add them with: python scripts/kit_setup.py --apply-copilot-rules. A value of true runs the command without asking; false, or approve false, always asks, even after an earlier approval. The Azure CLI uses the last --method given, so a get call that names a method a second time (--method, an abbreviation of it, or -m) always asks. This is a kit file.
